title: Cap. IV Arg. 7 Sol: Minor — Ego salvabo credentes shows equal mercy/justice; discrimination from acts
pass_a_gloss: I come to the Minor, in which it is affirmed that the decree of saving believers, and of condemning unbelievers, is that praeordination according to which God declares his mercy toward some, his justice toward others. We confess that according to this decree the mercy of God toward some, and justice toward others, is looked upon and declared in the event: but in a far higher manner mercy puts itself forth in the decree of predestination, and justice in the decree of passing by. This decree, I will save believers, I will condemn unbelievers, considered in itself shows and makes mercy equally to all, shows and makes justice equally to all: It promises or exhibits nothing to Jacob and Peter which it does not under the same conditions promise and exhibit to Esau and Judas; it denies nothing to Esau or Judas which it does not under the same conditions deny to Jacob and Peter. For that Jacob and Peter become partakers of mercy and eternal life, Esau and Judas do not, that discrimination did not flow from diversity of decrees as to the persons themselves, but from diversity of the persons in their operations.
pass_b_english: Now the Minor: that the decree to save believers and condemn unbelievers is the praeordination by which God declares mercy toward some and justice toward others. We grant that on that decree mercy and justice are seen and declared in the event — but mercy puts itself forth far higher in the predestination decree, and justice in the decree of passing by. I will save believers, I will condemn unbelievers, taken in itself, shows and makes mercy equally to all, justice equally to all. It promises Jacob and Peter nothing it does not under the same conditions promise Esau and Judas; it denies Esau or Judas nothing it does not under the same conditions deny Jacob and Peter. That Jacob and Peter share mercy and eternal life while Esau and Judas do not comes not from diverse decrees about the persons, but from the persons' diversity in their operations.
source_text: Accedo ad Minorem, in qua affirmatur, decretum salvandi credentes, et condemnandi incredulos, esse illam praeordinationem secundum quam Deus erga alios declarat misericordiam suam, erga alios justitiam suam. Fatemur juxta hoc decretum spectari et declarari in eventu misericordiam Dei erga alios, et erga alios justitiam: verum longe altiori modo exserit se misericordia in praedestinationis decreto, et justitia in decreto praeteritionis. Decretum hoc, Ego salvabo credentes, Ego condemnabo incredulos, in se consideratum omnibus ex aequo ostendit et facit misericordiam, omnibus ex aequo ostendit et facit justitiam: Nihil promittit aut exhibet Jacobo et Petro, quod non sub iisdem conditionibus promittit et exhibet Esavo et Judae; nihil negat Esavo aut Judae quod non sub iisdem conditionibus negat Jacobo et Petro. Nam quod Jacobus et Petrus participes fiant misericordiae et vitae aeternae, Esavus et Judas non fiant, id discriminis non fluxit ex decretorum diversitate quoad ipsas personas, sed ex personarum diversitate in suis operationibus.
